issues.description: Methods getLectureName() and getNumberOfInscribedStudents(): the exercise text and tests ask students to "Implement getters for each attribute" (public API) but the solution implementation declares two getters with private visibility. Problem statement: requests public getters (task list references getLectureNameTest(), getNumberOfInscribedStudentsTest(), etc.). Template repository: starts from a TODO and does not provide implementations. Solution repository: defines getLectureName() as 'private String getLectureName()' and getNumberOfInscribedStudents() as 'private int getNumberOfInscribedStudents()'. This visibility mismatch makes the intended public API unclear and will prevent external code/tests from calling these getters, causing tests that expect public getters to fail or confusing students about the required access level.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the visibility of the getters to public so they match the exercise description and test expectations. Specifically, in both solution and template (when providing example implementations) replace 'private String getLectureName()' with 'public String getLectureName()' and replace 'private int getNumberOfInscribedStudents()' with 'public int getNumberOfInscribedStudents()'. Ensure all other attribute getters are public as well so the class API is consistent with the problem statement and tests.
